audience: AI、新科技、新产品兴趣用户
开发者、产品经理、互联网从业者
希望通过 AI 提升效率或寻找机会的人

refresh.note: The cards, the motion segments and the covers were rendered before the dark brand base was adopted: the paper surface #f2f4f5, the ink #0a1f3d and the accent #b03a2e. The DNA declares the target; the next render must regenerate them under brand.palette before any new cut is published.

brand.palette_note: accent is the one brand colour; problem is a literal failure marker that may only appear while the failure exists and must not survive into the resolution frame

narrative.cta: 先把 CLI 线跑一遍，再决定要不要用。

template_coverage.deferred_reason: The locked script has no cost figures, and inventing one is forbidden. The cost and limit analysis is the next episode's hook, not a stretch of this cut.
template_coverage.note: A 45-60 s cut carries five of the seven template beats. The DNA says which, so a missing beat is a declared omission rather than a silent one.

caption_style.highlight_note: The burn path applies one uniform style per cue. Per-cue highlight needs an ASS cue writer, which no shipped step owns yet; until one does, a marked cue renders in the base colour.

cover.composition: 居中主体，单行粗主标题，底部小字冲突一句话

evidence.crop_rule: 只保留日志、报错、运行结果、模型输出区域
rules: 录屏是事实证据，AI 生成的矢量图与卡片不得伪装成实测结果
录屏片段与静态证据裁切同等有效，条件是都来自同一次真实捕获
裁掉杂乱桌面、无关窗口、多余弹窗
命令与结果必须来自同一次录制
先出现一次带上下文的完整结果，之后才允许放大

voice.persona: 28-35 岁中低音，略带沙哑磁性，冷静理性，不带情绪煽动

bgm.style: 低音量暗氛围电子乐，无鼓点，无跳跃节奏
bgm.reason: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY unavailable; the video_ops loudness-regression fallback is prohibited

qc_rules: 每个事实镜头都能追溯到一次真实录制或一份真实回执
画面里不出现未裁掉的桌面、弹窗或凭据
口播没有夸大与营销式话术，局限与坑必须讲清楚
关键结论与风险点在字幕里用强调色标出
封面留白 ≥30%，单行主标题，底部一行冲突句
静音后单独听一遍，口播仍然成立且不含平台违规话术
人工审核通过前不发布，也不生成任何发布链接
platform_note: 抖音 9:16 为主，1080×1920，前 3 秒必须给出反常识结论或翻车冲突；小红书同源 3:4 封面走 card-xiaohongshu，标题 ≤20 字，3–5 个垂直话题标签，不带泛标签。

skill_route.why: owns the hook variants, the second-by-second script and the cover wording
owns the palette, the type hierarchy and the density gate for every card and cover
owns the vector data-flow animation; a bare ffmpeg chain is not allowed

owns SRT to ASS conversion in the account caption style, the line and line-count overflow gate, and the ffmpeg burn; narration timing comes from the audio stage via Easel TTS, and the upstream auto-subtitle skill is not invoked by this pipeline
the pinned composition path; called through assemble_easel.py, never modified
owns the technical verdict; it never grants production readiness
owns the angle, hook variants, retention lint and claim-to-scene map above the deterministic script checks
owns one explicit visual direction per episode and the anti-fatigue ratio; stops a card-only look
owns the per-beat material duty, rights fields and naming contract before acquisition
owns the rights-aware candidate record (page, creator, licence text and URL, score) that the assets stage validates and a ledger row must descend from
owns the recording brief per beat (surface, what must be visible, 9:16 crop, cursor, redaction) before anyone records; the storyboard stage refuses a card that stands in for an operation
owns how a beat is classified, which sources are in scope, and where the cutaway lands relative to the spoken word
the compositor-neutral shot recipe vocabulary; re-express in HyperFrames, never run its Remotion assets

title: Easel 实测：能跑，但 Web 工作台六项没过
description: 我把它锁在 v0.2.1，982 个文件逐个核对哈希；doctor 是绿的，但网关健康检查那一行是红的，Web 工作台六项没过。结论：不是开箱即用，但 CLI 和 Skill 线今天能用。

evidence_ladder.rule: A lower rung never proves a higher one. A view is not a like, a like is not a question, a question is not a customer.
evidence_ladder.note: Only a real URL and a real metrics snapshot move a rung. No number here may be inferred from another platform.

business.proposition: 把跑不起来、效果不好、只能 Demo 的 AI 项目，修到可验证、可交付、可交接的状态。
business.rule: Content may feed the business; it may not move the OPC stage. Stage changes are a business decision, not a content outcome.

cadence.rule: Four videos come from one or two real sources. Never four sources, and never a made-up source to hit the quota.

metrics.how: two consecutive weeks deliver the planned count
every published video has a real platform URL
record founder minutes and handoff count per video
record the real extra cash spend per video
share of videos a human approves on the first review
every key fact binds to a verifiable source
qualified platform assets produced per source
explicit questions, technical discussion or reproduction requests
qualified consult, pilot or paid request
topic and process adjusted from real results
